name: shdr-24
title: SHDR-24
description: A Minecraft Earth: a voxel planet marched block by block, its ground a perfect sphere with oceans flush on it and mountains, forests and deserts rising above. An integrated season clock weathers the whole world through five climates — lush, cherry grove (flat pink blossom puffs over vivid meadows), ice (packed-ice spires, glacier patches, frozen seas), mesa (big terraced terracotta towers, red sand, cacti) and desert; the deep stone runs clustered ore veins whose texture flecks glow, and caves warm toward a molten core that blazes as the agent speaks. Thinking streams the terrain and races the seasons, so continents morph like chunks loading.
